jobs.title: Medical ICU Clinical Nurse Coordinator in Las Vegas, NV
jobs.snippet:
Medical ICU Clinical Nurse Coordinator in Las Vegas, NV

Staff Position

# Medical ICU Clinical Nurse CoordinatorSunrise Hospital & Medical CenterLas Vegas, NV

$51-77/hour

Posted 2 days agoFrom the

futureYou.personTheyWillBecome: A confident Senior ICU Nurse and emerging Nurse Training Coordinator at a leading Can Tho hospital (Vinmec, S.I.S, or Nam Can Tho), commanding 950-1,200 USD monthly with formal ICU certification, documented training credentials, and a proven track record of mentoring junior nurses and improving clinical protocols. You will be the trusted bridge between bedside nursing excellence and departmental leadership, recognized for both your clinical judgment and your ability to develop others.
futureYou.achievementSummary: Completed ICU-specific nursing certification (TNCC or equivalent), secured promotion to Senior ICU Nurse role at an international hospital, trained and mentored 8+ junior nurses on ICU protocols, earned English proficiency certification (TOEFL/IELTS B1+), and transitioned into formal Nurse Training Coordinator responsibilities within 2 years—positioning yourself for future Nursing Unit Head (Điều Dưỡng Trưởng) advancement.

phases.goal: Establish credibility as a clinical expert and close the certification gap to qualify for Senior Nurse roles at international hospitals
actions: Enroll in and complete a Trauma Nursing Core Course (TNCC) or ICU Certification Program (through Red Cross Vietnam or international provider), targeting completion within 4 months
Document and organize a portfolio of your 4-year ICU experience: 10-15 case studies demonstrating critical care decision-making, patient outcomes, and emergency response scenarios
Launch daily English language practice (30 minutes) using Duolingo and medical-English platforms (MedEnglish.com), tracking vocabulary gains in healthcare management and patient communication
Interview 3 current Senior ICU Nurses at Vinmec/S.I.S Can Tho (via LinkedIn or professional networks) to understand the unwritten requirements, certifications valued, and career progression pathways
Apply to 5-7 Senior Nurse ICU positions at international hospitals (Vinmec, S.I.S, Phương Châu) emphasizing your training capability and 4-year clinical depth, even if slightly underqualified
Join the Vietnamese Nursing Association (Hội Điều Dưỡng Việt Nam) and attend one monthly local chapter meeting to build professional network and stay current on regulations
skills: ICU Certification and Trauma Nursing Competency (TNCC or equivalent)
Clinical Documentation and Case Study Portfolio Development
Professional Networking and Relationship Building in Healthcare
Self-Directed Learning and Continuous Professional Development
phases.milestone: Successfully complete ICU Certification (TNCC or equivalent), achieve English B1 proficiency (demonstrated via language app metrics or mock exam), and receive at least 2 formal interview offers for Senior ICU Nurse roles at international hospitals in Can Tho

phases.goal: Secure Senior ICU Nurse position and begin formal nursing education/training leadership responsibilities to build credibility for Nurse Training Coordinator role
actions: Accept Senior ICU Nurse position at Vinmec, S.I.S, or Nam Can Tho (target: 900-1,050 USD/month) and negotiate a clause allowing 2-4 hours weekly for training/mentorship activities

Formally design and lead 2-3 ICU orientation modules for new nursing staff (e.g., 'Emergency Response Protocols,' 'Patient Handoff Systems,' 'Medication Safety in Critical Care'), documenting learning outcomes and trainee feedback

Complete a Nursing Leadership or Healthcare Management Certificate Program (online, 4-6 months) through HCMC University of Health Sciences or equivalent, focusing on team management, quality improvement, and adult learning principles
Establish a mentoring relationship with 3-5 junior ICU nurses, documenting monthly progress notes on their skill development and creating personalized learning plans for each mentee
Create a 'ICU Best Practices' resource library (digital or printed) including protocols, checklists, and training guides tailored to your hospital's systems, shared with the nursing team
Present one departmental training session or quality improvement initiative at a hospital staff meeting or Can Tho nursing conference, establishing visibility as a thought leader
skills: Nursing Education Design and Adult Learning Theory
Quality Improvement and Clinical Protocol Development
phases.milestone: Secure and complete 6+ months in a Senior ICU Nurse role at an international hospital, complete a Nursing Leadership certificate, successfully mentor at least 3 junior nurses with documented progress, and be formally recognized or approached about training coordinator responsibilities by your department

phases.goal: Transition into formal Nurse Training Coordinator role and build a pathway toward Nursing Unit Head (Điều Dưỡng Trưởng) leadership position
actions: Transition into a formal Nurse Training Coordinator position (target: 1,050-1,200 USD/month) at your hospital, taking ownership of all new hire onboarding, continuing education, and competency assessments for the ICU/critical care unit
Develop and implement a comprehensive nursing competency framework for your unit, including skills checklists, assessment timelines, and career progression pathways for junior nurses
Pursue advanced certification in Nursing Education or Healthcare Administration (online or part-time, 1-2 years) from a recognized Vietnamese or international institution

Lead 2-3 major quality improvement projects (e.g., reducing hospital-acquired infections, improving patient handoff communication, streamlining emergency protocols) with measurable outcomes, documenting and presenting results
Build relationships with 3-5 international hospitals or nursing organizations (Singapore, Thailand) to explore benchmarking opportunities and stay current with regional healthcare standards
Apply for Nursing Unit Head (Điều Dưỡng Trưởng) or Nursing Supervisor positions within 3-4 years, leveraging your training record, quality improvements, and leadership experience
skills: Nursing Education Program Design and Evaluation
Quality Improvement and Patient Safety Leadership
International Healthcare Standards and Best Practices
phases.milestone: Secure a formal Nurse Training Coordinator role with documented responsibility for staff development and onboarding, successfully implement and measure at least one major quality improvement initiative with tangible clinical outcomes, and be positioned as a credible internal or external candidate for a Nursing Unit Head position
